x_timeline_post.description: A single post in a scrolling timeline: avatar, name/handle, timestamp, body text, optional media/chart-embed, action bar below.

rules.message: Action-bar buttons below the 44pt minimum touch target
Timestamps should read as relative ('3h', '2d') in a timeline, not absolute, to match the reference convention

x_action_bar.description: Reply / repost / like / share row beneath a post. Each action shows its count only after the user has data to justify one; icons fill (color) on activation, not before.

rules.message: Action icons should come from one consistent icon family, not mixed weights/styles

tradingview_watchlist_row.description: One row in a watchlist/quote list: symbol, last price, change value + change percent, direction color, optional intraday sparkline.

rules.message: Row tap target below the 44pt minimum touch size
Price/change columns should use tabular (monospaced-digit) figures so values don't visually jitter as they update

tradingview_technical_rating_gauge.description: The Strong Sell → Strong Buy semicircle gauge summarizing an aggregate of MA/oscillator votes, with the needle position and a vote breakdown beneath it.

rules.message: buy_votes + sell_votes + neutral_votes must equal the total votes the needle position implies
Fewer than ~30 bars of history behind the rating makes the aggregate statistically thin; disclose or suppress rather than show a confident needle

trading212_order_ticket.description: The simplified buy/sell entry sheet: mode toggle (buy/sell), quantity-vs-value toggle, single confirm action, estimated cost/proceeds shown before commit.

rules.message: The primary confirm action is a high-consequence control and should exceed the generic 44pt minimum
Estimated total must recompute as quantity/value changes, not show a stale figure

trading212_holding_row.description: One row in a holdings/portfolio list: logo, name, quantity or weight, current value, unrealized P/L (value + percent).

rules.message: Row tap target below the 44pt minimum touch size
